function.name: read_skill_file
function.description: Returns the text of a file from the Deathbot skill (a fact card, a template or a guide). The person does not see it.

path.description: Path relative to the skill, e.g. cards/cpr.md

function.name: update_notes
function.description: Replaces the working notes shown to the person under Your file. Markdown.

function.name: update_progress
function.description: Updates the map of the conversation shown to the person under Your file. Send only the items that changed. An id that is not one of the standard areas creates a new item and needs a title. `next` replaces the list of suggested next steps.

id.description: A standard area id, or a short id of your own for a new item

summary.description: One short line shown under the title

title.description: Only for a new item of your own: the title shown to the person

next.description: Ids of up to two items to show as suggested next steps. Send an empty list to clear them.

function.name: reply
function.description: Says something to the person, with anything you want to show them alongside it. This ends your turn: the page shows the reply and waits for the person. Tool calls in the same response still run, but you see their results only on your next turn, so read what you need before replying.

text.description: What you say to the person, in markdown. Shown as your message.

replies.description: Optional ready-made answers, each written as the person would say it. Shown as buttons under your message; tapping one sends it.

card.description: Optional: a fact card to show as a block the person can open and read, with its sources, e.g. cards/cpr.md

video.description: Optional: a video to embed. Only links that appear in a fact card are accepted.

note.description: One or two sentences shown above the video, saying what the person will see.

document.description: Optional: a document shown with buttons to read, print, copy and download, and kept under Your file. Sending the same kind again replaces the earlier one there, except kind "other".

kind.description: summary for "What matters to me"; other for anything else

scenes.description: Optional: one to three pictures, drawn after your message is shown and shown together under it. Usually under a minute; gives up after two. Governed by guide/images.md in the skill.

title.description: Short label, e.g. 'In intensive care on a breathing machine'

prompt.description: The full prompt given to the image model

use_photo.description: Base the pictures on the photo the person added. Ignored if they have not added one.

health_records.description: Optional: show the two-step block for bringing in health records: a link to health-skillz, and a button to choose the downloaded records file. The records arrive later with one of the person's messages.

function.name: search_health_records
function.description: Searches the loaded health records (clinical notes and structured entries) for words. Returns matching notes with snippets, and matching entries.

query.description: One or more words that must all appear, e.g. 'ejection fraction' or 'palliative'

function.name: list_health_records
function.description: Lists entries of one kind from the loaded health records, newest first, one line each.

type.description: A FHIR resource type, e.g. Condition, MedicationRequest, Observation, Encounter, Procedure, AllergyIntolerance, Immunization

contains.description: Optional: only entries whose line contains this text, e.g. 'creatinine'

function.name: list_files
function.description: Lists the files the person shared that are kept in this browser as text (too long to send whole, or JSON), with ids and sizes.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Searches the stored files for passages containing all the given words. Returns snippets with the file id and the offset to read from.

query.description: One or more words that must all appear near each other

function.name: read_file
function.description: Reads a stored file: 40,000 characters (about 10,000 tokens) from an offset, or with whole set, the entire file up to 400,000 characters.

offset.description: Character offset to start from; default 0

whole.description: Return the entire file in one go

function.name: read_pdf_pages
function.description: Reads pages of a stored PDF by page number: as text (up to 20 pages per call), or with as_images, as pictures of the pages showing layout, tables and figures (up to 5 pages per call).

as_images.description: Return the pages as images instead of text

function.name: read_health_record
function.description: Returns one item from the loaded health records: a clinical note by its id (e.g. note-0-12), in pages of 12,000 characters, or a structured entry (e.g. Observation/abc), cut off at 8,000 characters.

offset.description: For long notes: character offset to continue from
